mapper.sql: m.id, m.monitor_type, m.platform, m.marketplace, m.item_id, m.store_id, m.listing_id, m.seller_sku, m.benchmark_id, m.brand, m.title, m.main_image, m.category, m.rank_main, m.sub_category, m.rank_sub, m.rating, m.review_count, m.seller_count, m.price, m.currency, m.listing_status, m.last_snapshot_date, m.auto_fetch, m.last_fetch_time, m.last_fetch_message, m.rank_drop_percent, m.rating_drop, m.notify_user_id, m.status, m.remark, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_time, s.name AS store_name, b.item_id AS benchmark_item_id, b.title AS benchmark_title, u.nickname AS notify_user_name
FROM ecom_monitor m LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = m.store_id LEFT JOIN ecom_monitor b ON b.id = m.benchmark_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.notify_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.monitor_id, p.snapshot_date, p.rank_main, p.rank_sub, p.rating, p.review_count, p.seller_count, p.price, p.listing_status FROM ecom_monitor_snapshot p JOIN ecom_monitor m ON m.id = p.monitor_id WHERE p.monitor_id IN #{id} AND p.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(p2.snapshot_date) FROM ecom_monitor_snapshot p2 WHERE p2.monitor_id = p.monitor_id AND p2.snapshot_date < m.last_snapshot_date)
